newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTT Exploration says natgas output back to normal.
newsitem.headline: PTT Exploration says natgas output back to normal.

text.p: Thailand's PTT Exploration and Production Plc said on Thursday that natural gas production from the offshore Bongkot field had returned to normal after a recent temporary maintenance shutdown.

PTTEP said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that as of this morning, the natural gas production in the field which is located in the Gulf of Thailand resumed its normal capacity of 350 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd).
The operator of the field shut down parts of its facilities for repair and maintenance in March, resulting in a drop of production to 285 mmcfd for that month.
Bongkot gas field is operated by Total Exploration and Production Co Ltd, a unit of Total SA. PTTEP has a 40 percent stake in the Bongkot project.
